1.original_instruction: Whenever the player considers herself ready to become a Dancer, head to Comodo . Near the Kafra employee, there will be a male NPC named Bor Robin who will grant entrance into the Dancer Quest area.
1.short_ru: У Bor Robin рядом с Kafra в Comodo войдите в область испытания Dancer.
1.short_en: Enter the Dancer test area through Bor Robin near Kafra in Comodo.
1.full_ru: Когда будете готовы получить профессию Dancer, отправляйтесь в Comodo. Рядом с сотрудником Kafra найдите Bor Robin: он пропустит вас в область Dancer Quest.
1.full_en: Whenever the player considers herself ready to become a Dancer, head to Comodo . Near the Kafra employee, there will be a male NPC named Bor Robin who will grant entrance into the Dancer Quest area.

6.original_instruction: Once finished signing up, it's time to head to the right side of the stage and talk to Bijou to take the quiz.
6.short_ru: У Bijou справа от сцены начните викторину.
6.short_en: Start the quiz with Bijou on the right side of the stage.
6.full_ru: Завершив регистрацию, идите направо от сцены и поговорите с Bijou, чтобы начать викторину.
6.full_en: Once finished signing up, it's time to head to the right side of the stage and talk to Bijou to take the quiz.

7.original_instruction: The quiz involves a simple Q & A session. Getting 80% correct is required to pass this part of the exam. For reference, the following are the questions that are asked for this section of the exam. (The wording however, may differ)
7.short_ru: Ответьте правильно минимум на 80%; используйте набор, соответствующий текущим вопросам Bijou.
7.short_en: Answer at least 80% correctly; use the reference set matching Bijou's current questions.
7.full_ru: Викторина состоит из вопросов и ответов. Для прохождения нужно ответить правильно на 80%. Ниже приведены вопросы этого испытания; формулировки могут отличаться. Справочные вопросы и ответы: набор A. Справочные вопросы и ответы: набор B. Справочные вопросы и ответы: набор C.

8.original_instruction: After passing the quiz, Bijou will send the player to Dance on the stage. At this point one should make sure to equip a Bow and some arrows and then head behind the stage to meet another NPC with a "Waiting Room" chat window above her head. Entering the chatroom will put the player on queue for the trial.
8.short_ru: Экипируйте Bow и arrows, затем у another NPC за сценой войдите в «Waiting Room».
8.short_en: Equip a Bow and arrows, then join “Waiting Room” at another NPC behind the stage.
8.full_ru: После викторины Bijou отправит вас танцевать на сцене. Экипируйте Bow и несколько arrows, затем идите за сцену к another NPC с чатом «Waiting Room». Войдите в чат, чтобы встать в очередь на испытание.
8.full_en: After passing the quiz, Bijou will send the player to Dance on the stage. At this point one should make sure to equip a Bow and some arrows and then head behind the stage to meet another NPC with a "Waiting Room" chat window above her head. Entering the chatroom will put the player on queue for the trial.

28.original_instruction: Arrow Shower or Double Strafe For those future dancers who are having problems with this part of the test: An effective way to pass this exam is to only perform the first and last steps for sequences with more than two steps, rather than hitting all the tiles. For example: instead of doing "Left Center Right Back" one simply goes from Left to Back.

Header Consumed/Varies is not allowed to override the detailed retention note.

Thirty literal question/answer pairs are restored from HTML in three reference branches. Match live questions; source says wording may differ and does not prove random assignment. Elder Willow is an example obvious non-Jazz answer. Comodo Beach is the actual offered answer; source says Kokomo beach is not an option. Quiz-only NPC/item/monster references do not become travel, collection or kill objectives.

Dance tiles are ordered movement actions, not geographical coordinates or dialogue answers. Pose means hold position. Improve Concentration is explicitly optional. Source corrects the live Front, Right text to Right only. Long sequences have exclusive full/first-last branches with context proof from later source step 28; shortcuts are source advice, not server-verified guarantees.

One final poring must be killed with a bow; its actor ID is unknown and not borrowed from a generic Poring link. Arrow Shower/Double Strafe are alternative attacks, not literal menu options. Bow/arrows are generic equipment categories with unknown IDs/counts. Final Line/Rope IDs use exact own-guide links, with exclusive Job Level 50/below-50 rewards.

Aile, Bijou, Bor Robin and the unnamed waiting-room host remain separate. Another NPC is a descriptive label, not an invented game name. No coordinate, map code or female-character eligibility flag is inferred from narrative pronouns.
